title: médico pediatra
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do
Hospital Municipal Pedro II
.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O
Centro de Tratamento de Queimados
é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
Realizar consultas no Pronto Atendimento Pediátrico, unificando dados contidos em prontuários e prescrevendo medicamentos; passar em visita aos pacientes internados, avaliando a recuperação dos mesmos; encaminhar pacientes para exames, tratamentos e cirurgias específicas quando necessário.

Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino Superior completo em Medicina

Residência Médica ou título de Especialização na área

Registro ativo no conselho da classe

RQE em Pediatria

Experiência em Pediatria

Informações adicionais
Hospital Municipal Pedro II/ CER Santa Cruz - RJ

description:
Somos um Grupo formado por marcas que possuem mais de 45 anos de experiência na área da saúde, e estamos presentes nos estados do Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Espirito Santo e Ceará realizando mais de 456 mil consultas anuais e cuidando da vida de mais de 100 mil pacientes. Nossa identidade foi construída equilibrando o foco em pessoas com uma gestão eficiente, por isso, valorizamos profissionais que sejam curiosos, acolhedores, que tenham calor humano, que transmitam confiança, mas que também sejam eficientes, ágeis, assertivos, orientados a resultados e processos.

Somos movidos pelo propósito de criar um Brasil ativo e sem dor, transformando relações na saúde, oferecendo um ecossistema de excelência a pacientes com doenças musculoesquelético e de terapia assistida.

Estamos em transformação e buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte da nossa história, mas para trabalhar conosco você precisa se reconhecer nos nossos valores:

FOCO NAS PESSOAS

Nossos valores


Pessoas são o nosso DNA: Somos justos nas relações com os pacientes, colegas de trabalho, parceiros e prestadores de serviço. Incentivamos sonhos e valorizamos as pessoas por suas competências.

Simplificamos para fazer bem feito: Antecipamos os problemas e buscamos realizar as atividades da forma mais eficiente, agindo de imediato e de forma coordenada com foco na solução.

Queremos mais: Buscamos incansavelmente a evolução, valorizando feedbacks e nos preocupando em sempre entregar a melhor experiência.

Empoderamos as pessoas: Somos proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-la para outros.

Se você quer fazer a diferença, achou o lugar certo

Venha fazer história com a gente

SomosVitus #PorUmaVidaSemDor


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Responsável pela execução e controle das rotinas financeiras relacionadas à tesouraria, garantindo a integridade, confiabilidade e conformidade das informações financeiras do Grupo.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Realizar a conciliação bancária diária, assegurando a correspondência entre os registros financeiros das empresas do Grupo e os extratos bancários.
  • Executar a conciliação da prestação de contas do caixa particular das unidades de atendimento.
  • Analisar, identificar e investigar discrepâncias entre registros internos e extratos bancários, propondo correções e garantindo a conformidade das informações.
  • Monitorar e acompanhar o desempenho do sistema de VAN Bancária, assegurando a correta integração e processamento das informações.

  • Realizar o monitoramento diário do caixa, acompanhando a posição de saldos bancários.
  • Executar estornos e devoluções relacionados a pacientes, conforme políticas internas e procedimentos financeiros.
  • Prestar apoio às rotinas do setor de Tesouraria, contribuindo para a organização e eficiência dos processos.
  • Manter alinhamento contínuo entre as equipes financeira e contábil, atuando de forma colaborativa na resolução de divergências identificadas.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Ensino Superior cursando ou completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Gestão Financeira ou áreas relacionadas;
  • Pacote Office Intermediário;

  • Experiência em Conciliação Bancária;
  • Atuação na área de Saúde;

  • Nos óbitos, supervisionar o preparo adequado do corpo, evoluir em prontuário e comunicar a assistente social e supervisão;

The Engineer II performs engineering design review and analysis assignments, typically involving a significant project or several smaller, less complex projects.   • Ability to deliver complex messages in simple and understandable ways, both verbally and in writing

description:

Partner with the best

The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. title: Regional Medical Officer South America – Rio de Janeiro
description:
The Operations Department of MSF OCB (Operational Centre Brussels) is made up of 8 managerial and technical teams called Cells or Regional Support Teams (RST), each in charge of a portfolio of countries and 1 Emergency Team (E-Unit) for the management of intense emergency interventions. These teams directly supervise and support the implementation on the projects.

The Regional Support Team (RST5) is a team of 6 people based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil and a regional pharmacy advisor working remotely. It is planned to transfer Haiti from the Cell 3 portfolio to the RST5 portfolio from the second quarter of 2025. The countries currently managed by the RST 5 are: Brazil and Venezuela. The countries are indicative, as a re-shuffling of the portfolio within the Operations department occurs on a regular basis.

As a Medical Officer (MO), you will play a key medical role in the operations of RST 5. You support the Medical Coordinators to safeguard the medical quality of the projects. It is a critical position to ensure a strong overview and support in the preparation and implementation of our projects.

In terms of scope, your support will be focused on the Haiti project, with particular emphasis on hospital management and on supporting local teams with international medical orders. You will also provide specific assistance to other projects in the RST5 portfolio, most probably Venezuela, due to the important supply challenge.

You will report to the Regional Medical Team Leader of RST5 and functionally linked to the Medical Operational Manager in the Medical Department of OCB.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES


The core function is to enhance and optimize the operational support and guidance of the projects, ensuring achievable and context-adapted quality of care.

Strategy Implementation Planning

  • Co-define and co-design the Medical Operations (MedOps) strategy implementation with the medical coordination teams and the Regional Medical Team Leader of RST5
  • Provide strategic input, leadership, and guidance to ensure plans are practical, achievable, and aligned with the medical priorities within the countries of interventions, in coordination with the Regional Medical Team Leader

Strategic Oversight and Monitoring

  • Ensure comprehensive monitoring and follow-up of the implementation of the medical strategy in all MSF operations through regular and ad hoc support to the medical coordination's

Project Implementation

  • Provide regular support to medical coordinators in the follow-up and implementation of projects in coordination with the Regional Medical Team Leader
  • Offer ad-hoc support as needed, ensuring that medical coordinators have the resources and assistance they need in agreement with the Regional Medical Team Leader

Policies and Guidelines Management

  • Ensure that medical resources, policies, and guidelines are relevant, appropriate, available, and effectively managed in the countries of interventions
  • Regularly interact and coordinate with the medical referents to ensure that policies, guidelines, and guidance adapted/tailored to the medical operations and specific project's context and objectives

Quality of Care (QoC) implementation

  • Ensure and actively monitor the implementation of Quality of Care (QoC) standards and improvement plans across all projects
  • Guide the medical teams in the programs to develop and enforce quality monitoring and improvement initiatives

Medical Activity Analysis

  • Responsible for monitoring and analyzing medical activities and ensuring data-driven decision-making in collaboration with the Regional Medical Team Leader
  • Review and analyze medical reports and data, providing constructive feedback and involving the medical referent as required

Tool improvement and development

  • Propose improvements to existing management and tracking tools (dashboards and internal control mechanisms, etc.) that are user-friendly, effective and context adapted to enhance the oversight of medical programs

Medical stock strategy and management

  • Oversee the review, planning, and validation of the medical standard list and medical forecasts, including emergency preparedness (EPREP)
  • Revise and validate medical orders within the agreed framework (budget, activity scope, medical master, and standard list, etc.)
  • Define the medical stock management strategy and monitor its implementation (e.g., GSDP: "Good Storage and Distribution Practices", SoP's: "Standard Operating Procedures", etc.) in collaboration with the supply officer and project teams

Human Resources planning and management

  • Oversee the regular follow-up of projects' human resource needs, including the review and planning of HR requirements, together with the Regional Medical Team Leader
  • Ensure effective matching and follow-up with the Human Resources Officer (HRO) and Pool Managers (PMs), including the briefing and debriefing of key medical operations staff in the countries of RST 5, in agreement with the Regional Medical Team Leader

Budget

  • Ensure cost-awareness in medical decision-making, balancing quality of care with resources availability, context specificity and sustainability, in collaboration with the Regional Medical Team Leader
  • Participate in medical operations (MedOps) budget planning and management to ensure efficient allocation of resources for medical operations

Emergency Response

  • Participate in the medical support/guidance to the projects for emergency responses together with the Regional Medical Team Leader and medical department referents
  • Ensure rapid and effective deployment of resources and personnel in the event of emergencies in the countries of interventions of RST 5, in collaboration with the Regional Medical Team Leader

EPREP

  • Ensure that the Emergency Preparedness and Response Plan (EPREP), and scenarios are regularly updated and adapted to the evolving contexts in collaboration with the Regional Medical Team Leader

Technical Files

  • Provide first-line follow-up and input on technical files, according to specific expertise and in consultation with the Regional Medical Team Leader

Staff Health

  • Review and validate health policies for both International Mobile Staff (IMS) and Locally Hired Staff (LHS), ensuring comprehensive and effective healthcare provisions
  • Facilitate the management of staff health files between the countries of interventions and the Staff Health Unit (SHU) (including medical evacuations) in coordination with the Regional Medical Team Leader

Coordination with medical department

  • Engage with medical referents bilaterally or lead group discussions/working groups to support projects and enhance collaboration
  • Facilitate effective communication and coordination between medical field teams and the medical department
  • Participate in medical department meetings, in relevant circles and in MedOps meetings, contributing to department strategies with updates from the programs, and reverting relevant information's to the country teams

Communication and Information flow

  • Promote open communication and information flow within the RST, the medical department, and the countries of interventions of RST 5 on all MedOps-related issues
  • Maintain transparency and alignment across teams to foster a collaborative operational environment

Replace the RST5 Regional Medical Team Leader during absences or upon request, ensuring continuity of medical technical and strategic decision-making.

REQUIREMENTS


Education & Experience

  • Medical or paramedical degree
  • Minimum 3 years of MSF international experience
  • Minimum 1 year experience as Medical Coordinator, including projects focusing on secondary health care
  • Experience in hospital management is a must
  • Degree in Public Health or Epidemiology and/or basic knowledge of Humanitarian law is an asset
  • Experience in epidemics, public health, IDPs (Internal Displaced populations) and refugees, emergency responses are an asset

Competencies

  • Planning and organizing
  • Strategic vision/oversight
  • Negotiation and networking
  • Coaching & mirroring with the teams
  • Teamwork and cooperation
  • Comprehensive knowledge of humanitarian interventions
  • Results and quality orientation
  • Able to set priorities, make choices, and assume decisions
  • Strong cross-cultural awareness and adaptability

Languages

  • Excellent command of French and English is mandatory (oral and written)
  • Knowledge of Spanish and/or Portuguese isa a strong asset

CONDITIONS

  • Expected starting date: March 2025
  • Location: Rio de Janeiro (Brazil)
  • Mobility: minimum 30% in the countries of interventions of RST5
  • Contract type: Fixed-term contract – Full time
  • Contract duration: 12 months (extendable)
  • Salary and benefits according to MSF-OCB international grid for non-residents in Brazil and MSF Brazil grid for residents in Brazil
  • Family position, conditions according to hosting entity's policy
  • When in Rio de Janeiro, possibility of 2 days homeworking per week, to be defined locally
  • Adhere to the MSF principles and to our managerial values: Respect, Transparency, Integrity, Accountability, Trust and Empowerment
  • Adhere to the MSF Adherence to the MSF Behavioural Commitments

title: Oracle BRM Developer
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications leader, built to help enterprises unlock the full potential of mobile connectivity at scale. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including our own owned and operated global mobile core network, a full end-to-end eSIM technology stack, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide. Combined with our privileged access to the global wholesale telecom market, this positions us uniquely to deliver seamless, compliant, and scalable connectivity solutions anywhere in the world.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows and fund our growth independently—continuously investing in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own telecommunications offerings.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence. 

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Billing and Revenue Management (BRM) Expert to support our organization in optimizing billing operations and empowering our billing team. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise in BRM systems with strong communication and training skills, ensuring the team can effectively manage the billing system to support company's billing processes and help organize and adapt billing team processes and tools to the new billing system.

This role is designed to ensure the billing team not only has access to the right data but also the skills and confidence to use it effectively, with the BRM expert acting as both a technical authority and a trainer.
Key Responsibilities

System Expertise

  • Strong expertise in Oracle BRM, with special focus in the following areas
  • Product Design Center (PDC): configuration for realtime and offline events
  • Integration: Development of opcodes and expose them as REST APIs to manage complex simple and complex billing hierarchies
  • Product Catalog configuration (Oracle Price Design Center, PDC)
  • Invoicing: Invoice, Receipts and Credit Notes templates design (Oracle Analytics Publisher, OAP)
  • Billing Operations: bill cycle execution, financial reporting, troubleshooting

Diversidade e inclusão é uma prioridade de negócios para a Supergasbras. Valorizamos e acreditamos no desenvolvimento de pessoas, tanto no contexto profissional como pessoal, tendo como estratégia a equidade de gênero, inclusão de pessoas com deficiência, respeito a todas as orientações sexuais e luta contra a discriminação racial nas diferentes camadas da sociedade.

description:

Se você sonha em se tornar referência no mercado da estética, ser reconhecida como autoridade técnica, ministrar cursos, palestrar, ensinar, vender com propósito e construir sua imagem profissional atrelada a uma marca forte, essa oportunidade foi desenhada para você.

Na MedEstec, não buscamos apenas alguém para vender equipamentos. Buscamos uma profissional protagonista, que queira aparecer, contribuir, ensinar, influenciar e crescer junto com a empresa, deixando sua marca no mercado da estética avançada.

Sobre a MedEstec

A MedEstec é referência em tecnologias para a área da saúde e estética avançada, atuando com equipamentos e dispositivos como lasers, HIFU, criolipólise, radiofrequência e muito mais. Trabalhamos com marcas de alto padrão e uma proposta de integração entre tecnologia, conhecimento e resultado para profissionais da estética e harmonização facial e corporal.

Seu papel nessa jornada

  • Realizar vendas consultivas e estratégicas, sendo reconhecida como especialista e referência técnica;
  • Ministrar treinamentos técnicos para profissionais da saúde e estética como médicos, estetas e dermatofuncionais
  • Conduzir workshops, aulas práticas e demonstrações em instituições de ensino (graduação e pós-graduação);
  • Desenvolver e ministrar cursos e jornadas técnicas da empresa, com remuneração por bilheteria;
  • Capacitar e desenvolver tecnicamente a equipe comercial interna;
  • Oferecer suporte técnico e acompanhamento aos clientes, fortalecendo relacionamento e resultados;
  • Representar a MedEstec em eventos, cursos e ações de mercado, fortalecendo sua imagem e a da marca;
  • Colaborar com o marketing na criação de conteúdos técnicos, campanhas e materiais, tornando-se um rosto e uma voz da marca no mercado

Buscamos alguém que:

  • Seja graduada na área da saúde, com especialização em Estética ou Dermato-Funcional;
  • Tenha experiência com vendas na área da estética e goste de desafios comerciais;
  • Tenha boa comunicação, didática e presença, goste de ensinar e se posicionar;
  • Deseje aparecer, crescer, ser reconhecida e construir autoridade;
  • Tenha e queira aprofundar experiência com lasers, HIFU micro e macrofocado, criolipólise, radiofrequência, entre outras tecnologias.

O que oferecemos

title: Technical Services Senior Manager
description:
Department: Technical & Infrastructure
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
The Technical Services Senior Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, coordination, and delivery of all technical services across tournament venues, ensuring full alignment with FIFA requirements and international standards. The role leads the integration and operational readiness of venue infrastructure services including power systems (grid, overlay, and backup), containment, water and waste, HVAC, and broadcast technical support across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.
The position oversees the planning, execution, and supervision of technical services and infrastructure operations, managing power contractors and key suppliers, coordinating containment planning, and leading stadium technical inspections and independent audits. Working closely with internal teams, Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, service providers, and other stakeholders, the role ensures technical compliance, cross-functional alignment, and delivery excellence while maintaining timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Collaborate closely with key Functional Areas to define, refine, and validate technical services requirements, including power, containment, water and waste, HVAC, and floodlighting, across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.
Lead coordination with Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, power contractors, utility providers, and suppliers to ensure seamless planning, integration, and delivery of power solutions.
Support and contribute to procurement activities, including preparation of technical inputs for RFPs, participation in tendering processes, technical evaluations, and coordination with contracted suppliers and delivery partners.
Oversee the development, implementation, and performance of power infrastructure, including grid, overlay, and backup systems, ensuring alignment with FIFA standards and operational requirements.
Manage containment planning and execution, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient routing for power, broadcast, and other technical services.
Monitor progress, quality, and compliance of technical services works, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and mitigation measures.
Coordinate stadium technical inspections, readiness reviews, and independent technical audits, ensuring timely closure of findings and follow-up actions.
Ensure full compliance with FIFA technical guidelines and international standards, while balancing operational needs, timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.
Act as the central technical interface between Functional Areas, suppliers, and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, alignment, and decision-making.
Support procurement, contracting, and supplier performance management related to power, MEP and technical services, including scope definition and technical evaluation.
Contribute to continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and driving standardization and best practices across venues.
YOUR PROFILE
Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical or engineering field
A minimum of 8 years work experience in a technical services related field within Major Events/Sports Organization
Experience with Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling)
Strong technical knowledge in Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling, Entertainment)
Proficient in MS Office and planning software and online collaboration tools
Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
Availability to travel as needed

Be visionary

Teledyne Technologies Incorporated provides enabling technologies for industrial growth markets that require advanced technology and high reliability. These markets include aerospace and defense, factory automation, air and water quality environmental monitoring, electronics design and development, oceanographic research, deepwater oil and gas exploration and production, medical imaging and pharmaceutical research.​

We are looking for individuals who thrive on making an impact and want the excitement of being on a team that wins.

Job Description

Teledyne Marine is a group of leading-edge undersea technology companies that have been assembled by Teledyne Technologies Incorporated. Through acquisitions and collaboration, over the past 10 years Teledyne Marine has evolved into an industry powerhouse, bringing the best of the best together under a single umbrella. With technologies divided into 5 core segments; Imaging, Instruments, Interconnect, Seismic and Vehicles, Teledyne Marine sales staff can address not only brand level solutions, but turn-key, customized systems that leverage our full range of technology. Our goal is to provide one-stop purchasing capability, world-wide customer support, and the technical expertise to solve our customer's toughest challenges. A Sea of Solutions…..One Supplier.

For more information, visit our website at

POSITION WILL BE BASED IN Brazil - São Paulo

JOB SUMMARY:

The Sales Manager is responsible for Sales of Teledyne Marine products in the defined area both directly and through distributors, specific responsibility to support the Central & South America's for Teledyne Marine's Imaging & Instruments and Vehicles verticals.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsibility to build and maintain an active pipeline in a CRM, Salesforce, to exceed orders and sales targets on a quarterly, and annual basis.  

  • Provide accurate booking forecasts and keep up-to-date customer and pipeline records.

  • Actively manage the channels to ensure they are fully engaged, optimized, and driven to succeed.

  • Develop and drive a regional sales strategy to maximize market penetration of Teledyne Marine Instruments & Imaging and Vehicles products including new market entries both direct and with channel partners.

  • Orchestrate and hold technical seminars, product presentations and customer demonstrations direct and in conjunction with partners and channels.

  • Remain informed of competitor status, products, advantages, and weaknesses.

  • Develop and maintain a solid understanding of market conditions and trends.

  • Identify opportunities and capture market share growth while collaborating with the Teledyne Marine businesses to optimize efforts.

  • Be responsible for discovering Teledyne Marine non-standard sales opportunities and participate in the selling process in collaboration with product management.

  • Understand fully the benefits and functionality of each of the products in Teledyne Marine Instruments & Imaging and Vehicles portfolio and how they compare within the market.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent experience

  • Relevant background/education in a maritime organization would be advantageous, specifically hydrography.     

  • Retired Naval Officer with Hydrography experience is a plus

SKILLS:

  • Strong interpersonal acumen, communicate effectively from entry level to C-suite customers.

  • Languages needed – English, Spanish, Portuguese, all at working level.

  • Excellent communication ability with all nationalities, written as well as verbal.

  • Ability to have or attain good comprehension of technical/maritime issues.

AUTHORITIES:

  • Providing quotations to Agents/Reps within pricing authority

  • Providing quotations to customers within pricing authority

  • Recommend termination and hiring of Agents/Reps within the region based on defined performance criteria

METRICS:

  • Booking Target

  • Revenue Target

  • Quarterly reports on Agents / Reps

  • Ability to provide timely and accurate booking prognosis.

  • Ability to provide qualitative feedback on market conditions and trends, new customer applications and product ideas

  • Ability to report competitive activity

Teledyne and all of our employees are committed to conducting business with the highest ethical standards. We require all employees to comply with all applicable laws, regulations, rules and regulatory orders. Our reputation for honesty, integrity and high ethics is as important to us as our reputation for making innovative sensing solutions.

title: Manager, Business Development
description:
The Business Development Manager drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Account Management and Commercial Operations Core Process.  This position is the core sales position within the company responsible for new business and clients as well as managing and leveraging existing accounts.  The Business Development Manager drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts.  

What You Will Do:

  • Contribute to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).
  • Sell ABS services using the strength of local affiliates' business structure.
  • Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility.
  • Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management.
  • Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action.
  • Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate.
  • Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
  • Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company's CRM.
  • Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited university or equivalent business/quality-related experience.
  • 5 or more years of experience in the industry is preferred.
  • Business experience in the manufacturing and/or technical service industry.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Self-motivated professional with a track record of sales leadership.
  • High energy professional with a commitment to succeed in sales and business development.
  • Facile with computers, both in preparing presentations and communications and in working within ABS QE's operating platforms.
  • Familiarity with management systems is helpful.  Otherwise, the ability to learn new areas quickly will be critical.
  • Sensitive to multicultural environments.
  • Excellent communicator both with customers and the sales team.
  • Focus on the result; strong desire to achieve objectives despite challenges.
  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy. 

Reporting Relationships:

Reports directly to the Director of Business Development or senior level manager.

title: Manager, Business Development
description:
Job Description
The Business Development Manager drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Account Management and Commercial Operations Core Process. This position is the core sales position within the company responsible for new business and clients as well as managing and leveraging existing accounts. The Business Development Manager drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts.
What You Will Do:
Contribute to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).
Sell ABS services using the strength of local affiliates' business structure.
Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility.
Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management.
Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action.
Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate.
Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning.
Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company's CRM.
Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets
What You Will Need:
Education and Experience
Bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent from an accredited university or equivalent business/quality-related experience.
5 or more years of experience in the industry is preferred.
Business experience in the manufacturing and/or technical service industry.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
Self-motivated professional with a track record of sales leadership.
High energy professional with a commitment to succeed in sales and business development.
Facile with computers, both in preparing presentations and communications and in working within ABS QE's operating platforms.
Familiarity with management systems is helpful. Otherwise, the ability to learn new areas quickly will be critical.
Sensitive to multicultural environments.
Excellent communicator both with customers and the sales team.
Focus on the result; strong desire to achieve objectives despite challenges.
Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
Reporting Relationships:
Reports directly to the Director of Business Development or senior level manager.
About Us
We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.
ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. title: Analista de Conteúdo Multimídia
description:
Descrição e Responsabilidades:
Horário: 9h às 18h
Nível: Profissional
Regime de contratação: Efetivo – CLT

1. COMO É SER ANALISTA DE CONTEÚDO MULTIMÍDIA EM MSF-BRASIL:

Você irá produzir conteúdos audiovisuais originais, criativos e inovadores para os canais de Médicos Sem Fronteiras no Brasil, o que inclui a captação, edição e adaptação de imagens e áudios em alinhamento às prioridades e demandas do Hub de Engajamento Estratégico, contribuindo para ampliar a visibilidade da organização e das crises humanitárias em que atua e fortalecer o engajamento com o público, atuando com atenção à representatividade, ao uso responsável de imagens e narrativas, e mitigação de vieses na produção audiovisual.

2. QUAIS SERÃO SEUS DESAFIOS?

  • Transformar informações complexas em produtos audiovisuais de fácil compreensão, envolventes e capazes de se conectar com novas audiências;
  • Sugerir soluções engajadoras e impactantes para os conteúdos disponibilizados pelo movimento, tendo em vista as prioridades do movimento e as estratégias do Hub;
  • Desenvolver conteúdos audiovisuais relevantes, buscando e sugerindo tendências de mercado e de outros escritórios de MSF;
    Contribuir para que conteúdos audiovisuais representem pessoas, contextos e crises humanitárias de forma ética, respeitosa e não estereotipada, reconhecendo e ajustando possíveis vieses narrativos e visuais.

3. COMO É O DIA A DIA DA POSIÇÃO?

  • Propor roteiros e soluções criativas para materiais audiovisuais, considerando os objetivos, audiências específicas e cuidados com representatividade, linguagem e possíveis vieses, em alinhamento com a Coordenação;
  • Criar e produzir conteúdos audiovisuais originais junto à equipe de conteúdo, atuando em todas as etapas do processo, da captação de imagens à finalização, assegurando uso ético de imagens, respeito aos contextos culturais e atenção à dignidade das pessoas retratadas;
  • Editar, otimizar e adaptar vídeos e imagens disponibilizados pelos escritórios internacionais e projetos da organização, considerando o contexto local, adequação cultural e possíveis riscos de interpretação;
  • Criar e adaptar peças gráficas (cards para redes sociais, anúncios, infográficos, mapas, banners, flyers, relatórios, etc.), considerando diferentes formatos e objetivos, observando diversidade de representações, evitando estereótipos e alinhando a comunicação aos princípios éticos e humanitários de MSF;
  • Criar e desenvolver a proposta visual para campanhas institucionais, de captação de recursos e sobre as temáticas que MSF atua, em conjunto com as áreas e com base nos respectivos briefings, orientações recebidas e objetivos estratégicos da área;
  • Realizar a cobertura fotográfica/audiovisual de eventos e de atividades de MSF-Brasil, incluindo também a edição, o arquivamento e a entrega do material produzido dentro dos prazos acordados;
  • Acompanhar as prioridades de pauta do movimento internacional MSF, assim como as prioridades estratégicas do Hub e de MSF-Brasil, para sugerir soluções e garantir o alinhamento da produção audiovisual;
  • Acompanhar tendências de novos formatos e linguagens audiovisuais para compartilhar com a equipe e produzi-los, com o apoio da Coordenação, caso relevantes e alinhados às estratégias de MSF-Brasil;
  • Apoiar, quando necessário, a publicação dos conteúdos nos canais digitais, como o portal de MSF-Brasil e os perfis de redes sociais;
  • Garantir que todo material produzido e seus respectivos projetos estejam organizados e arquivados no diretório de audiovisual de MSF-Brasil, ou em outra plataforma interna indicada;
  • Quando necessário, fazer o upload dos conteúdos audiovisuais no Media Data Base de MSF Internacional ou outras plataformas de comunicação interna;
  • Participar da rede de profissionais de audiovisual de MSF por meio da presença em fóruns e webinars para trocar experiências, contribuir para sinergia do grupo e sugerir melhores práticas;
  • Adotar metodologias ágeis e ciclos curtos de entrega, com aprendizado contínuo e flexibilidade para adaptação às mudanças.

Requisitos:

4. O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER?

  • Experiência com gravação, edição de vídeos e design gráfico para comunicação visual online e offline
  • Conhecimentos de ferramentas como: Pacote Office, Adobe-Première, Adobe After-Effects e Adobe Photoshop, entre outras para edição de imagens
  • Conhecimentos de storytelling/criação de roteiro
  • Noções básicas de diversidade, equidade e inclusão aplicadas à comunicação humanitária, narrativa visual e uso de imagens
  • Ter conhecimentos de inglês intermediário - você terá oportunidade de desenvolver o idioma conosco

5. O QUE AUMENTA SUAS CHANCES?

  • Interesse por causas humanitárias e comunicação de impacto
  • Conhecimentos de ferramentas de gestão de redes sociais

6. QUAIS SÃO AS COMPETÊNCIAS NECESSÁRIAS?

Você precisará ter pensamento analítico para identificar soluções e oportunidades criativas além do óbvio, interpretando demandas e contextos de forma crítica para propor entregas eficazes. Também será essencial ter orientação de serviço para acolher feedbacks e sugestões com abertura, buscando compreender o público e os objetivos de cada demanda. Além disso, será necessário planejamento e organização para gerenciar prazos e imprevistos, antecipando desvios e propondo alternativas viáveis, e iniciativa e inovação para sugerir abordagens mais eficientes e alinhadas às necessidades do trabalho.

PRINCÍPIOS E CULTURA DE SALVAGUARDA:

MSF está em busca de pessoas que compartilhem do compromisso com uma cultura de salvaguarda, que visa garantir um ambiente seguro e acolhedor para todas as pessoas. Buscamos promover e garantir a Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão (DEI) em todas as nossas ações e práticas. Assim, fortalecemos nossa missão e asseguramos que todas as pessoas tenham a oportunidade de contribuir e crescer na organização. Candidaturas que demonstrem alinhamento com esses valores serão altamente valorizadas.

Alinhada com os valores que orientam as ações da nossa organização em todo o mundo, consideraremos apenas a candidatura de pessoas que cumpram os requisitos estabelecidos e se identifiquem como pessoas pretas.

Venha fazer parte da equipe de Médicos Sem Fronteiras Brasil

PRAZO PARA INSCRIÇÃO: 26/02/2026

RETORNO:

Ficamos muito felizes com o seu interesse em trabalhar em MSF Gostaríamos de reforçar que, ao final do processo, todas as pessoas candidatas receberão um retorno sobre sua participação.

Sobre a empresa:

Uma indústria de ideias a serviço do progresso.
Liderança. Confiança. Expertise.

Fundada em 1954 com o objetivo inicial de atuar nas áreas de investigação e sondagem de solos, a Sondotécnica foi, ao longo do tempo, ampliando sua gama de serviços, passando a oferecer estudos de barragens e ingressou na consultoria para a construção de hidrelétricas. Foi pioneira nas áreas de hidrologia, oceanografia e transporte de sedimentos, também adquiriu conhecimento de estruturas, elaborando projetos de edifícios, complexos industriais e até pontes. Com o forte investimento em pesquisa, treinamento e qualificação, a empresa diversificou sua área de atuação e hoje presta serviços em vários segmentos de infraestrutura, com foco na execução dos projetos, gerenciamento, fiscalização e supervisão de obras. A Sondotécnica hoje é líder em consultoria de engenharia no Brasil, com mais de 3 mil projetos executados e mais de 400 clientes atendidos. Hoje, a Sondotécnica oferece sua expertise para empreendimentos nos setores de: – Transporte – Saneamento – Habitação – Urbanização – Energia – Indústria – Meio Ambiente – Irrigação.

Sobre a vaga

Elaboração e detalhamento de projetos de geotecnia e estruturas de contenção sob supervisão técnica pontual. Inclui:

  • Realização de visitas técnicas para a coleta de dados e acompanhamento da execução dos projetos.
  • Programação, acompanhamento, controle de medição e interpretação de investigações geológico-geotécnicas.
  • Elaboração de seções geológico-geotécnicas e modelos 3D com os horizontes de solo.
  • Projetos de Aterros sobre Solos Moles

  • Estruturas de Contenção
  • Projetos de Túneis
  • Projetos de Barragens
  • Projeto de Fundação e Estruturas Enterradas
  • Projetos de Instrumentação

  • Projetos de rebaixamento de lençol freático

  • Pode liderar equipes de projetos, sob acompanhamento do coordenador de área;

  • Pode ser responsável pela verificação técnica de documentos elaborados por outros integrantes da equipe;
  • Pode atuar junto ao coordenador na gestão da coordenação técnica de geotecnia.

Requisitos:

  • Formação: Graduação de Engenharia Civil com especialização em Geotecnia. Desejável mestrado na área de Geotecnia.
  • Conhecimentos: AutoCAD Civil 3D; Autodesk Revit; Softwares de Análises Geotécnicas (Equilibrio Limite, Elementos Fintos, etc.); Conhecimento de Geotecnina (Mecânica dos Solos, mecânica das Rochas e Geologia de Engenharia).

Bachelor's degree in computer science/engineering

Ownership, you look for solutions and do not pass on problems.

Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD‑102)

title: Tax Analyst
description:
What will you be doing?
O Analista Fiscal de Impostos Indiretos é responsável por garantir a correta apuração, recolhimento e cumprimento das obrigações acessórias relacionadas aos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, ISS, PIS, COFINS), assegurando conformidade com a legislação vigente e alinhamento aos procedimentos internos da empresa
What experience would we like you to have?
Apuração de Tributos Indiretos: Realizar cálculos e conferência de ICMS, ICMS-ST, IPI, ISS, PIS e COFINS, garantindo a correta aplicação das alíquotas e regras fiscais.

Gestão de Créditos e Débitos: Controlar créditos de ICMS, PIS/COFINS e regimes especiais, assegurando aproveitamento conforme legislação.
Suporte a Auditorias e Fiscalizações: Preparar documentação e relatórios para atender auditorias externas e fiscalizações, fornecendo informações precisas e tempestivas.
Análise de Operações: Avaliar operações de compra, venda, transferência e serviços, identificando riscos fiscais e propondo soluções para mitigá-los.
Atualização Legal: Monitorar alterações na legislação tributária e implementar ajustes necessários nos processos internos.

O Grupo Bradesco Seguros é um conglomerado segurador da Organização Bradesco, que tem atuação multilinha em âmbito nacional nos segmentos de Seguros, Capitalização e Previdência Complementar Aberta, atuando com empresas que detém representatividade nos respectivos segmentos: Bradesco Seguros, Bradesco Saúde, Bradesco Auto/RE, Bradesco Vida e Previdência, Bradesco Capitalização, Mediservice e Novamed.
Estamos constantemente procurando por pessoas conectadas com o nosso propósito, que sejam apaixonadas por impactar vidas e que queiram construir carreira.
Todas as pessoas são bem-vindas, valorizamos a Diversidade, a Equidade e a Inclusão e entendemos que elas favorecem o crescimento pessoal e profissional, amplia a capacidade de entender e estimula o respeito à individualidade e à privacidade do ser humano.
O Grupo Bradesco Seguros busca ampliar a discussão, a sensibilização, a conscientização e a mobilização em prol do tema de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão. Conheça as iniciativas.
Se identificou com a gente? Então inscreva-se para ter a oportunidade de participar de nosso processo seletivo e fazer parte da nossa história
O Que Você Precisa Ter
Coren Técnico de Enfermagem ativo;
Pacote Office;
Desejável vivência com sistema de prontuário eletrônico do paciente (MV Soul).
O Que Você Irá Entregar
Prestar assistência de enfermagem segura, humanizada e individualizada aos clientes, cumprindo as orientações médicas e de enfermagem, seguindo as normas vigentes de atendimento de enfermagem para atingir as expectativas de qualidade dos pacientes;
Preparar pacientes para consultas e exames, orientando sobre condições de realização dos mesmos verificando os exames solicitados e suas necessidades específicas de preparo prévio e aferindo sinais vitais e dados necessários ao atendimento médico e de enfermagem, evitando que exames sejam cancelados por orientação ou preparo inadequado e maximizando o tempo de consulta médica;
Seguir protocolos e orientações de rotina disponíveis na unidade verificando sinais vitais e condições gerais do paciente, preparar e administrar medicações por via oral, tópica e endovenosa; realizar a movimentação e o transporte de clientes de maneira segura; executar atividades de limpeza de materiais e equipamentos, bem como seu armazenamento e controle, conservação e distribuição para colaborar com a equipe multidisciplinar na prestação de assistência de qualidade e segurança, recuperando e promovendo a saúde dos pacientes atendidos na clínica;
Prestar assistência durante atendimento de urgência e emergência, administrando medicações conforme orientação médica e de enfermagem; seguindo padrão preconizado para atendimento de suporte básico de vida afim de promover os cuidados necessários para oferecer suporte básico de vida;
Implementar ações e definir estratégias para promoção da saúde, participar de trabalhos de equipes multidisciplinares e orientar equipe para controle de infecção, identificando as necessidades em saúde dos pacientes sob assistência na unidade e propondo ações de promoção da saúde da população para minimizar danos decorrentes de estilos de vida de risco, relacionados a hábitos, alimentação, atividades físicas e uso de medicamentos.
Local de trabalho: São Bernardo do Campo

title: Finance Analyst
description:
Vacancy Name

Finance Analyst

Vacancy No

VN3988

Operating Company

InterMoor do Brasil Group

Advert

Intermoor, Acteon's Moorings and Anchors business line, provides project and operational management expertise to customers across the mooring lifecycle. By combining operational knowledge of mooring equipment, anchor handling and industry failure modes with subsea engineering expertise, we create a company unmatched within the mooring niche. This approach mitigates risks in delivery, installation and operations across the lifecycle, reducing mooring lifecycle costs and safeguarding major operations that protect start-up schedules when mooring and mooring intervention are on the project or production critical path.

InterMoor is looking to add a Finance Analyst to the team. The Finance Analyst is responsible for performing daily and monthly financial activities, including accounting entries, reconciliations, financial reporting, and interaction with external accounting partners. The role supports cash flow management, billing, payables, receivables, and assists with administrative and HR-related tasks when needed. It reports directly to the Finance Manager.

The successful candidate will be based in the Rio de Janeiro area.

**Please submit Resumes/CVs in English.

Duties

  • Post accounting entries into the integrated system

  • Analyze balance sheet and P&L accounts

  • Perform bank reconciliations and cash flow analysis

  • Handle foreign exchange closings

  • Execute billing, accounts payable and receivable processes

  • Liaise with external accounting firms

  • Perform other duties inherent to the role

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting

  • 1 to 2 years of experience in similar roles

  • CRC (Regional Accounting Council registration), preferred

  • Knowledge of accounting and taxation

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, etc.)

  • Intermediate English

  • Navision/Business Central system knowledge is a plus

Hoje, somos centenas de cooperativas financeiras com atuação em todos os estados brasileiros, sempre regidas por esses valores.

title: Advogado(a) Pleno
description:
Na Ecopetrol Brasil, nosso compromisso é fornecer energia que transforme o futuro, alinhando desenvolvimento sustentável e inovação tecnológica. Somos parte de um grupo integrado de energia com operações globais, que abrange desde a exploração e produção de hidrocarbonetos até transporte, refinaria e comercialização. Além disso, estamos presentes em negócios de biocombustíveis e infraestruturas essenciais. Nosso objetivo é impulsionar a transição energética, reduzindo nossas emissões de carbono e contribuindo para um mundo mais sustentável, com a meta de atingir emissões líquidas zero até 2050.
Junte-se à Ecopetrol Brasil
Estamos buscando um(a) Advogado(a) Pleno para atuar em modelo híbrido, em nosso escritório localizado em Botafogo – RJ.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Assessorar a empresa em questões regulatórias junto à ANP, CNPE, MME e demais órgãos reguladores;
Apoiar na condução de processos administrativos regulatórios, incluindo cessões, atualizações cadastrais, submissão de documentos e diligências junto à ANP;
Analisar, revisar e elaborar contratos típicos do setor, como JOAs, SPAs, contratos de consórcio, concessão e partilha de produção, GSAs, GTAs, MOUs;
Revisar e aprimorar contratos corporativos padrão, manuais, políticas internas, mitigando riscos jurídicos;
Elaborar e revisar documentos legais e regulatórios do setor, incluindo licenças, certidões, contratos de exploração e produção e pareceres sobre normas de órgãos reguladores;
Preparar documentação para inscrição e qualificação em licitações e leilões da ANP, garantindo qualidade e cumprimento de prazos;
Prestar suporte legal contínuo às áreas corporativas, garantindo conformidade regulatória e corporativa;
Participar de fóruns da indústria, interagir com órgãos reguladores e apoiar na interface com escritórios de advocacia externos;
Apoiar controles internos e auditorias jurídicas, regulatórias e corporativas;
Identificar riscos legais e regulatórios, propor soluções preventivas e monitorar mudanças na legislação aplicável à indústria de exploração e produção.
Requisitos e qualificações:
Graduação em Direito;
Atuação comprovada em contratos corporativos;
Desejável experiência e conhecimento na indústria de óleo e gás;
Inglês avançado/fluente;
Espanhol será considerado diferencial.

title: Human Resources Administrator
description:
• Located in Barra da Tijuca, Brazil
  • Full Time Position, Monday – Friday 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.

The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM's web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

The Human Resources Administrator provides day-to-day administrative and operational support across core Human Resources functions in Brazil, ensuring compliance with Brazilian labor legislation (CLT), applicable collective bargaining agreements, and internal company policies. This role supports employee lifecycle processes including onboarding/offboarding, employee record maintenance, benefits administration support, recruitment coordination, HR reporting, and employee inquiry response. The HR Administrator handles confidential employee information in accordance with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD) and maintains accurate documentation required for audits and statutory reporting.

Tasks:

  • Support the end-to-end onboarding and offboarding process, including collection and validation of mandatory personal documents, coordination of pre-employment medical examinations (ASO), and preparation/maintenance of employment documentation.
  • Maintain accurate physical and digital employee personnel files (contracts, amendments, acknowledgements, and supporting documentation) and ensure records are up to date.
  • Coordinate HR data entry, updates, and reporting in HRIS (e.g., ADP WorkforceNow or local systems) and support required submissions and recordkeeping for Brazil (e.g., eSocial data coordination as applicable).
  • Provide administrative support for benefits and statutory programs, responding to employee questions regarding benefits and leave (e.g., vacation scheduling, meal/transportation vouchers where applicable) and routing complex items to HR leadership or vendors.
  • Coordinate recruitment administration, including job postings support, interview scheduling, candidate communications, and onboarding logistics.
  • Support compliance activities by tracking key dates and documents (e.g., probationary period checkpoints, contract renewals for fixed-term hires, and required acknowledgements).
  • Assist with internal HR communications and policy administration, including distribution of policies, collection of employee acknowledgements, and maintaining policy records.
  • Partner with local stakeholders (e.g., accounting/payroll providers) to support timely processing by providing accurate employee data and documentation, while maintaining confidentiality and data privacy controls.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of HR administrative processes, templates, and checklists to increase accuracy, speed, and compliance readiness.

Compliance and Data Privacy (Brazil): 

  • Work is performed in alignment with CLT requirements and any applicable collective bargaining agreements, including proper documentation of the employment relationship.
  • Maintain confidentiality and process personal data in accordance with LGPD principles (purpose limitation, necessity, security, and accountability).
  • Support accurate recordkeeping needed for statutory obligations and inspections, escalating questions to HR leadership or legal counsel as appropriate.

Skills and Knowledge: 

  • Working knowledge of core HR administration practices and familiarity with Brazilian Labor concepts (CLT) and HR documentation standards.
  • High attention to detail, strong organization, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Professional communication skills: English proficiency (written and verbal) required.
  • Discretion and integrity when handling confidential employee information and sensitive issues.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and comfort learning HRIS/payroll portals.
  • Strong customer-service orientation and ability to work collaboratively with employees and cross-functional partners.

Supervisory Responsibilities:  

This position has no supervisory responsibilities; however, it provides administrative support and guidance to employees on HR processes and directs questions to appropriate stakeholders when needed.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work: 

This is a full-time position.  As such, the Human Resource Administrator is eligible to participate in the regional benefits program offered to Katalyst employees.

Standard days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with flexibility as needed to support business requirements and local timekeeping practices.

Travel: 

Occasional local travel may be required for this position. If an offsite meeting or errand is requested, eligible mileage reimbursement will follow company policy and applicable local guidance.

Required Education and Experience  

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three (3) to five (5) years of experience in HR administration, HR operations, or a similar role.
  • Experience supporting onboarding documentation, personnel file maintenance, and benefits/employee inquiries.
  • Experience working with HRIS platforms (e.g., ADP WorkforceNow) and coordinating HR data updates and reporting.HR certification or coursework (local or international) is a plus.

  • Modelo de trabalho: Presencial
  • Horário de trabalho: Seg à Sexta de 07h às 17h, sábados alternados de 07h às 14h

Resumo:


Realizar manutenções preventivas, corretivas e preditivas em sistemas de refrigeração, climatização e HVAC, incluindo testes, ajustes, lubrificação, monitoramento e correção de anomalias para garantir o adequado funcionamento dos equipamentos.

Responsabilidades:

  • Cálculo de Carga Térmica: Avaliar o ambiente de instalação, dimensionar o local, identificar fontes de calor e especificar a capacidade do equipamento de ventilação ou refrigeração.
  • Especificação de Materiais e Acessórios: Definir tipo, modelo e tensão do equipamento, analisar projeto de instalação, avaliar local de instalação e requisitar materiais.
  • Instalação de Equipamentos: Selecionar ferramentas e equipamentos, medir o local de instalação, interpretar normas e procedimentos, instalar tubulações e drenos, interligar unidades evaporadoras e condensadoras e efetuar instalações elétricas.
  • Instalação de Ramais de Dutos: Marcar posições, confeccionar peças, montar e fixar dutos, acoplar juntas elásticas de vibração e registros de regulagem de ar.
  • Montagem de Tubulações de Refrigeração: Estabelecer percurso, dimensionar comprimentos, nivelar e fixar tubulações, efetuar pré-limpeza e pressurizar tubulações.
  • Aplicação de Vácuo: Despressurizar o sistema, conectar bomba de vácuo, instalar vacuômetro e monitorar pressão do vácuo.
  • Carga de Fluido Refrigerante: Conectar manômetros, cilindro de fluido refrigerante, expurgar o ar da mangueira e controlar a pressão do fluido refrigerante.
  • Testes nos Sistemas de Refrigeração: Verificar condições de alimentação elétrica, acionar equipamentos, controlar variáveis do sistema e monitorar funcionamento dos dispositivos de proteção e controle.
  • Checklist em Sistema de HVAC: Monitorar parâmetros de funcionamento do equipamento Chiller, unidades de tratamento de ar e realizar reparos quando necessário.
  • Execução de Tarefas Adicionais: Executar outras tarefas de mesma natureza e nível de complexidade associadas ao ambiente organizacional.
  • Monitoramento de Pressões, Temperatura e Umidade: Monitorar pressões, temperatura e umidade em salas classificadas e áreas de pesagem e amostragem.

Escolaridade:

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Técnico em Refrigeração;

Competências Técnicas:

  • Experiência prévia na área;
  • Desejável conhecimentos técnicos em Mecânica / Refrigeração / Elétrica.
  • Vivência em indústrias farmacêuticas, cosméticas ou alimentícias será considerada um diferencial.

Benefícios:

  • Vale transporte;

title: Especialista de Remuneração
description:
Jeito DaVita

O Jeito de Ser DaVita significa que nós dedicamos nossas Mentes, Corações e Mãos para atingir a Missão, vivenciar os Valores e construir uma Aldeia saudável. Cuidamos uns dos outros com a mesma intensidade com que cuidamos dos nossos pacientes.

Gostou? Junte-se a nós e faça a diferença na sua vida e na de nossos pacientes Vamos juntos construir a melhor comunidade de saúde que o mundo já viu

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver, revisar e implementar a Política de Remuneração, assegurando alinhamento às práticas de mercado e à estratégia organizacional.
  • Conduzir pesquisas salariais e estudos de mercado para validação e atualização das tabelas salariais.
  • Realizar saneamento, revisão e manutenção da estrutura de cargos, incluindo descrição, enquadramento e avaliação.
  • Analisar, validar e aprovar movimentações de pessoal (promoções, transferências, mudanças de jornada e enquadramentos), em interface com os clientes internos, assegurando equidade interna, competitividade externa e aderência orçamentária.
  • Realizar a validação e aprovação de vagas, garantindo alinhamento com a estrutura organizacional, política de remuneração e orçamento aprovado.
  • Apoiar a gestão orçamentária de pessoal, com análises, projeções e controle de impactos financeiros.
  • Elaborar análises e apresentações executivas para suporte à tomada de decisão.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Excel avançado (modelagem, análises e bases de dados).
  • PowerPoint avançado, com foco em apresentações executivas.
  • Conhecimento sólido em legislação trabalhista e práticas de remuneração.
  • Conhecimento avançado em orçamento e controle de custos de pessoal.
  • Desejável conhecimento nos sistemas Workday e ADP, especificamente nos módulos de Cargos e Salários.
  • Inglês avançado (desejável).
  • Pós-Graduação em Recursos Humanos (diferencial).
  • Power Bi avançado, com foco em dashboards (diferencial).

Informações adicionais

O que oferecemos?

Plano de Saúde: para cuidar do seu bem-estar e da sua família. "Porque saúde é o que interessa."

Plano Odontológico: para que o seu sorriso fique sempre impecável e bonito.

Vale Transporte: para facilitar o seu deslocamento.

Vale Alimentação e Vale Refeição: porque fazer compras vale mais que mil palavras.

Local de trabalho: Barra da Tijuca (modelo híbrido 1x na semana em Home Office)

Horário de trabalho: 09:00 às 18:00

Mais inclusão: Vaga elegível para pessoas com deficiência.

A DaVita é uma empresa de saúde que oferece serviços de diálise de alta qualidade em todo o Brasil. Chegamos ao Brasil em 2015 e no ano seguinte estávamos com 7 operações. Nossa estratégia de crescimento contínuo e dinâmico conta atualmente com mais de 100 operações.

Estamos presentes em 17 estados, atendendo mais de 20 mil pacientes com um time de mais de 6 mil colegas. No mundo, estamos presentes em 12 países, cuidando de mais de 200 mil pacientes renais em mais de 3 mil centros de diálise.

Atuamos em operações hospitalares e com clínicas para pacientes crônicos, além de um centro de acesso vascular. Prezamos pela Trilogia do Cuidado, pilar que guia a melhoria contínua na vida dos nossos pacientes, dos nossos colegas e do nosso mundo.

Nossos valores refletem o jeito DaVita de ser e imprimem em nosso dia a dia o comprometimento constante com excelência em servir, integridade, trabalho em equipe, aprimoramento contínuo, realização pessoal e diversão.

Caso você seja contratado, estes dados poderão ser armazenados por um período maior em decorrência da elaboração e execução do contrato de trabalho.
Para maiores informações sobre como é feito o tratamento de seus dados PESSOAIS, bem como seus direitos enquanto titular de dados, você pode enviar uma solicitação ao Encarregado, da Pierre Fabre.
Estamos convencidos de que a diversidade é uma fonte de realização, equilíbrio social e complementaridade para nossos funcionários, razão pela qual nossas ofertas estão abertas a todos, sem restrições.

title: Regional Partnerships Lead – Community-Led Tourism
description:
At Packed, we are building a decolonial, abolitionist alternative to mass tourism. Our mission is to reconnect travelers with local communities, protect culture from commodification, and ensure tourism uplifts rather than exploits.
We are looking for Regional Managers to join our growing global network. This role is not for those who see tourism as entertainment, but for those who understand its history of extraction in the Global South and want to transform it into a tool of repair and solidarity.
What you'll do:
Map and reach out to hostels, hotels, and guesthouses in your region.
Invite them to apply to become PACKED-certified accommodations.
Explain the benefits: certified partners are recommended to travelers and receive 5% of every experience booked through their unique code.
Build and maintain respectful relationships with local hosts, ensuring their voices remain central.
How it works:
Once an accommodation is certified, your role is complete. Your network might still get in touch with you in case they have specific demands.
From then on, you earn 10% of all experience sales in your region for as long as your contract remains active.
In other words: you work upfront to build partnerships, and in return you secure a passive, long-term income stream.
Qualifications
Required:
Strong communication skills in your local language and in English.
Availability to send and respond to emails at least once a day.
Deep love for your homeland and a genuine desire to protect your community.
Preferred:
Some knowledge of the tourism industry.
A personal history of traveling.
Why join us:
Be part of a decolonial movement that challenges mass tourism and gives power back to local communities.
Shape a new model of travel that resists exploitation and celebrates cultural integrity.
Create partnerships that generate lifelong impact and lifelong income.
This is not a traditional salaried job. It's an opportunity for those who believe in reclaiming tourism and want to grow with us - ethically, sustainably, and collectively.
If this resonates with you, apply through our website and help us make tourism a tool of justice, not exploitation.

title: Delayed Coker Visbreaker Specialist
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.
Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Delayed Coker/Visbreaker Engineering Specialist to join the Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD).
OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to Global Manufacturing operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.
Your primary role is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for refineries' delayed Coker and visbreaker, including both remote and on-site technical advisory support, benchmarking, and technology knowledge management
Key Responsibilities:
As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Conduct comprehensive performance reviews of existing delayed coker/visbreaker facilities, and analyze KPIs related to operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety.
Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations.
Provide hands-on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps from quarterly benchmarking reports.
Lead benchmarking and best practices exchange workshops among Global Manufacturing facilities (wholly-owned and affiliates), and facilitate knowledge sharing and continuous improvement in delayed coker/visbreaker technologies.
Deliver on-demand remote and field technical advisory support, including troubleshooting, optimization, debottlenecking, revamp, and upgrade activities and provide detailed service reports for each support activity.
Drive performance improvement programs that enhance process safety, optimize manufacturing costs, and increase plant reliability for delayed coker/visbreaker units.
Develop and implement best practices and standards for delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and maintenance, while ensuring alignment with industry standards and regulations.
Provide expert technical support to project teams and contractors for delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and procurement activities.
Coordinate with other disciplines (process, mechanical, instrumentation, and electrical) to ensure optimal performance and integration of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
Conduct regular audits and inspections of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment to ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality regulations and standards.
Evaluate and recommend new technologies and innovations for delayed coker/visbreaker improvement and optimization.
Minimum Requirements:
You will hold a Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering or a related field. An advanced degree is preferred.
You will have a minimum of 15 years of experience across the refinery and/or petrochemical industry, with at least 10 years of hands-on experience in delayed coker/visbreaker specialty.
You will be able to optimize delayed coker/visbreaker operations, with specific examples of performance improvements achieved.
You will have comprehensive knowledge of delayed coker/visbreaker processes, equipment, and systems in refining and petrochemical industries.
You will have deep understanding of ASME Section VIII Divisions 1 & 2, ASME Section I, API-530, API-535, API-537, API-560, API-579, API-936, and NFPA standards applicable to fired equipment.
You will have Significant experience in inspection and failure analysis of delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
You will have proficiency in basic and advanced NDE techniques related to delayed coker/visbreaker equipment.
High level of proficiency in using software tools related to delayed coker/visbreaker engineering and design, such as Aspen Hysys, ANSYS, and HTRI.
You will have knowledge of remaining life calculations for heater tubes and refractory design and repair.
You will have excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to prepare and present technical reports to various audiences.
You will also have strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.
Working environment:
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Our Vision
Building the world's leaders of tomorrow.
Our Mission
Designing the education system for the 22nd century.

Delta Institute is part of the Crimson ecosystem and focuses on delivering high-impact, future-facing learning experiences that help students stand out globally. Our programs sit at the intersection of education, industry, and innovation.
Through cohort-based programs and global partnerships, we give high school students access to hands-on, real-world learning experiences across industries such as technology, consulting, law, finance, design, and entrepreneurship.

As an Senior Operations Associate, Delta Careers, you are a core owner of program delivery and experience quality. You ensure that complex, multi-stakeholder programs run smoothly and feel seamless to students, mentors, and partners.
This is not a back-office role. You will sit at the center of program execution, working closely with mentors, program coordinators, internal teams, and external partners to deliver consistently high-quality experiences at scale.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys ownership, problem-solving, and making systems work better over time.

Program Ownership & Delivery
Own the operational execution of Delta Careers programs from start to finish.
Translate program goals into clear timelines, workflows, and day-to-day execution plans.
Ensure programs are delivered smoothly, on time, and to a high standard—even when conditions change.
Stakeholder & Relationship Management

Handle escalations calmly, professionally, and with a solutions-oriented mindset.
Continuous Improvement

Contribute to improving systems, templates, and processes so programs become more efficient and scalable over time.

Clear, professional written and verbal communication.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote or distributed environment.

High ownership mindset: you naturally take responsibility and see things through.

Thoughtful, people-centered approach when working with students, mentors, and colleagues.
Interest in building systems, not just executing tasks.

Students, mentors, and partners report a positive, well-supported experience.
Issues are anticipated and resolved proactively rather than reactively.
Internal teams trust you as a reliable owner of program execution.
Feedback and insights lead to visible improvements in how programs operate.
Program operations feel organized, clear, and scalable.
